metadata.title: झूम के झोंपड़े में घोंघी की सब्ज़ी | Skangbu Bai Khaukhlu Songmo | Food of Bru Tribe
metadata.description:
In this episode of Tribal Kitchen, we embark on a culinary journey with the Reang tribe, the second-largest community in Tripura. Known for their vibrant culture and deep connection with nature, the Reang people have a unique and rich food tradition. We'll be cooking a traditional dish called Swikamuk bai khaklu songmo, which holds a special place in their cuisine. Swikamuk refers to snails, while khaklu is white pumpkin, and songmo means curry in the Bru language. This delicacy is a harmonious blend of local ingredients, reflecting the tribe’s close relationship with their natural surroundings.

As we prepare this dish alongside a Reang family, you’ll also get an exclusive look at the traditional attire and ornaments worn by the Bru tribe. Their clothing, adorned with intricate designs and vivid colors, beautifully represents their heritage. The episode promises a rich mosaic of flavors, history, and culture, as we not only learn to cook a delicious dish but also delve into the customs and traditions that make the Reang tribe so unique. Join us for a celebration of food and culture in the heart of Tripura!
